cn-20261008-news-2.title: Double 11 Approaching: Platform Price Rules Tend to Be Standardized, What Consumers Should Pay Attention to Amid the Debate Between "Increasing Prices Before Discounting" and "Refund-Only"

segments.src: 每年双11临近,预售、满减、津贴、红包等各种优惠玩法都会陆续上线。近年来,随着价格监管不断细化,以及平台、商家与消费者之间围绕售后规则的讨论持续升温,今年的促销季呈现出一些新的特点:**价格更强调透明,比价更强调真实,售后规则也在寻求各方利益的平衡。**
segments.tr: As Double 11 approaches each year, various promotional activities such as presales, spending thresholds, allowances, and red packets are launched successively. In recent years, with the continuous refinement of price supervision and the heating up of discussions among platforms, merchants, and consumers regarding after-sales rules, this year's shopping season presents some new characteristics: **Prices emphasize transparency more, price comparison emphasizes authenticity more, and after-sales rules are also seeking a balance of interests among all parties.**

segments.src: 本文梳理当前值得关注的几个方向,帮助消费者在购物节前做好准备。需要说明的是,具体规则请以各平台公示的活动页面及监管部门的最新规定为准。
segments.tr: This article outlines several directions worthy of current attention to help consumers prepare before the shopping festival. It should be noted that specific rules shall be subject to the promotional pages publicly displayed by each platform and the latest regulations of regulatory authorities.

segments.src: ## 一、价格透明:促销规则为何越来越“讲清楚”
segments.tr: ## I. Price Transparency: Why Promotional Rules Are Becoming Increasingly "Clear"

segments.src: 长期以来,消费者对大促期间的价格存在不少疑问,例如:
segments.tr: For a long time, consumers have had many questions about prices during major promotions, such as:

segments.src: - 优惠到底怎么算,是否需要反复凑单、叠加多个条件才能享受?
segments.tr: - How is the discount calculated after all, and is it necessary to repeatedly combine orders and stack multiple conditions to enjoy it?

segments.src: - 标注的“原价”“划线价”是否真实存在过?
segments.tr: - Do the marked "original price" and "crossed-out price" actually exist?

segments.src: - 预售定金、尾款、红包抵扣的规则是否一目了然?
segments.tr: - Are the rules for presale deposits, final payments, and red packet deductions clear at a glance?

segments.src: 针对这些问题,我国《价格法》《价格违法行为行政处罚规定》《明码标价和禁止价格欺诈规定》等规则都明确要求,经营者应当明码标价,标示的价格信息应当真实、清晰,不得利用虚假或者使人误解的价格手段诱导消费者交易。近年来,监管部门也多次强调,要规范平台促销、引导经营者公平竞争。
segments.tr: In response to these issues, China's "Price Law", "Provisions on Administrative Penalties for Price Violations", "Provisions on Clearly Marked Prices and Prohibition of Price Fraud" and other rules clearly require that operators shall clearly mark prices, the marked price information shall be true and clear, and false or misleading price means shall not be used to induce consumers to trade. In recent years, regulatory authorities have also repeatedly emphasized the need to standardize platform promotions and guide operators into fair competition.

segments.src: 对消费者而言,这意味着在参与活动时,有权要求商家清楚说明优惠的计算方式、适用条件和有效期限。
segments.tr: For consumers, this means that when participating in activities, they have the right to request merchants to clearly explain the calculation method, applicable conditions, and validity period of the discounts.

segments.src: ## 二、“先涨后降”:如何看待虚假促销的争议
segments.tr: ## II. "Increasing Prices Before Discounting": How to View the Controversy of False Promotion

segments.src: 所谓“先涨后降”,通常指在促销前先抬高商品标价,再以“大幅降价”“史低价”名义销售,让消费者误以为获得了很大优惠。
segments.tr: So-called "increasing prices before discounting" usually refers to raising the product listing price before a promotion and then selling it in the name of "substantial price reduction" or "historically lowest price", making consumers mistakenly think they have obtained a huge discount.

segments.src: 按照现行规则,以下做法属于监管关注的重点:
segments.tr: According to current rules, the following practices are the focus of regulatory attention:

segments.src: 1. **虚构原价**:标示的原价在此前并未真实成交或公开销售过。
segments.tr: 1. **Fictitious original price**: The marked original price has not been truly transacted or publicly sold before.

segments.src: 2. **虚假比较**:与不真实、不可比的价格进行对比,制造“折扣很大”的印象。
segments.tr: 2. **False comparison**: Comparing with untrue and incomparable prices to create the impression of a "huge discount".

segments.src: 3. **规则不清**:优惠条件含糊,实际成交价与宣传不符。
segments.tr: 3. **Unclear rules**: Discount conditions are vague, and the actual transaction price does not match the promotion.

segments.src: 消费者在判断时,可以留意以下几点:
segments.tr: When making judgments, consumers can pay attention to the following points:

segments.src: - **关注近期价格走势**:借助平台自带的价格记录或可信的第三方工具,查看商品近期的实际成交价格。
segments.tr: - **Pay attention to recent price trends**: Use the price records built into the platform or reliable third-party tools to check the actual recent transaction price of the product.

segments.src: - **对比最终到手价**:不要只看划线价和折扣标签,应综合计算红包、津贴、满减之后的实际支付金额。
segments.tr: - **Compare the final actual payment price**: Do not just look at crossed-out prices and discount tags; comprehensively calculate the actual payment amount after red packets, allowances, and spending thresholds.

segments.src: - **保存页面信息**:下单前后对活动页、商品详情页截图留存,日后发生争议时可作为凭证。
segments.tr: - **Save page information**: Take screenshots of the activity page and product detail page before and after placing an order, which can be used as evidence when disputes arise in the future.

segments.src: ## 三、预售与尾款:细节决定体验
segments.tr: ## III. Presale and Final Payment: Details Determine the Experience

segments.src: 预售是双11的常见玩法,消费者通常先付定金,再在指定时间支付尾款。参与预售时,建议重点确认:
segments.tr: Presale is a common gameplay of Double 11, where consumers usually pay a deposit first and then pay the final payment at a designated time. When participating in presales, it is recommended to focus on confirming:

segments.src: - **定金能否退还**:不同商品、不同活动的定金规则可能不同,下单前务必阅读说明。
segments.tr: - **Whether the deposit can be refunded**: Deposit rules for different products and activities may vary, so be sure to read the instructions before placing an order.

segments.src: - **尾款支付的时间窗口**:错过时间可能影响优惠资格,需要提前设置提醒。
segments.tr: - **Time window for final payment**: Missing the time may affect discount qualifications, so reminders need to be set in advance.

segments.src: - **发货时间与物流承诺**:预售商品的发货周期通常更长,应确认承诺的发货时间。
segments.tr: - **Delivery time and logistics commitments**: The delivery cycle for presale products is usually longer, and the promised delivery time should be confirmed.

segments.src: - **价保与差价规则**:部分平台提供一定期限内的价格保护,但条件各异,应以具体页面说明为准。
segments.tr: - **Price protection and price difference rules**: Some platforms provide price protection within a certain period, but conditions vary and should be subject to specific page instructions.

segments.src: ## 四、“仅退款”之争:平台、商家与消费者的新平衡
segments.tr: ## IV. The Debate Over "Refund-Only": A New Balance Among Platforms, Merchants, and Consumers

segments.src: “仅退款”,一般指消费者在特定情形下,可以不退回商品而直接申请退款。该机制在保护消费者权益、提升售后效率方面有积极作用,例如商品严重不符、未收到货、存在质量问题等场景。
segments.tr: "Refund-only" generally refers to consumers being able to apply for a refund directly without returning the product under specific circumstances. This mechanism plays a positive role in protecting consumer rights and improving after-sales efficiency, such as scenarios where products are severely inconsistent, not received, or have quality problems.

segments.src: 但与此同时,也有商家,尤其是中小商家反映,在部分情况下规则可能被滥用,造成损失。围绕这一机制,各方的讨论主要集中在:
segments.tr: However, at the same time, some merchants, especially small and medium-sized merchants, report that in some cases the rules may be abused, causing losses. Centering around this mechanism, discussions among all parties are mainly focused on:

segments.src: - **适用边界**:哪些情形适用“仅退款”,哪些应当“退货退款”,需要更清晰的标准。
segments.tr: - **Applicable boundaries**: Which circumstances apply to "refund-only" and which should be "return and refund" require clearer standards.

segments.src: - **举证与申诉**:商家如何提交证据,平台如何公平、及时地处理申诉。
segments.tr: - **Evidence submission and appeal**: How merchants submit evidence and how platforms handle appeals fairly and timely.

segments.src: - **平衡保护**:既要保障消费者的合法权益,也要保护诚信经营的商家,避免规则被不当利用。
segments.tr: - **Balanced protection**: It is necessary to guarantee the legitimate rights and interests of consumers while also protecting honest merchants, avoiding improper use of the rules.

segments.src: 近年来,有关平台已陆续调整和完善相关规则,监管部门也强调要构建公平、可预期的交易环境。对消费者来说,最重要的是**依据真实情况合理使用售后权利**;对商家来说,则应完善商品描述、发货与客服流程,减少不必要的纠纷。
segments.tr: In recent years, relevant platforms have successively adjusted and improved relevant rules, and regulatory authorities have also emphasized building a fair and predictable trading environment. For consumers, the most important thing is to **reasonably use after-sales rights based on true circumstances**; for merchants, they should improve product descriptions, delivery, and customer service processes to reduce unnecessary disputes.

segments.src: ## 五、给消费者的实用建议
1. **理性消费,按需购买**:先列出清单与预算,避免被“限时”“限量”氛围带动而冲动下单。
segments.tr: 1. **Rational consumption, purchase on demand**: First list the checklist and budget to avoid impulsive orders driven by the "limited-time" and "limited-quantity" atmosphere.

segments.src: 2. **多渠道比价**:同一商品在不同渠道的价格、赠品、售后条件可能不同,综合比较更稳妥。
segments.tr: 2. **Multi-channel price comparison**: Prices, gifts, and after-sales conditions of the same product in different channels may differ, and comprehensive comparison is safer.

segments.src: 3. **看清规则再参与**:对满减门槛、红包使用条件、预售规则逐项确认。
segments.tr: 3. **Understand the rules before participating**: Confirm thresholds for spending reductions, red packet usage conditions, and presale rules item by item.

segments.src: 4. **留存证据**:保存订单、聊天记录、商品页面和支付凭证。
segments.tr: 4. **Retain evidence**: Save orders, chat logs, product pages, and payment vouchers.

segments.src: 5. **善用维权渠道**:遇到争议,可先与商家协商,再通过平台客服申诉;必要时可向消费者协会或市场监管部门的投诉渠道反映,例如全国12315平台。
segments.tr: 5. **Make good use of rights-protection channels**: When encountering disputes, you can first negotiate with the merchant, and then appeal through platform customer service; when necessary, you can reflect to consumer associations or complaint channels of market regulatory authorities, such as the national 12315 platform.

segments.src: 6. **注意个人信息与支付安全**:谨防仿冒客服、虚假退款链接等诈骗,不随意点击陌生链接,不向他人透露验证码。
segments.tr: 6. **Pay attention to personal information and payment security**: Beware of scams such as counterfeit customer service and fake refund links, do not click on unfamiliar links casually, and do not disclose verification codes to others.

segments.src: 从价格透明到比价真实,从预售规则到售后机制,今年双11折射出的趋势是:电商促销正在从“拼噱头”走向“拼规则、拼信任”。对平台和商家而言,规范经营才能赢得长期口碑;对消费者而言,了解规则、保留证据、理性判断,才是享受促销红利的前提。
segments.tr: From price transparency to authentic price comparison, from presale rules to after-sales mechanisms, the trend reflected by this year's Double 11 is: E-commerce promotions are shifting from "gimmick-driven" to "rule-driven and trust-driven". For platforms and merchants, standardized operations can win long-term reputation; for consumers, understanding rules, retaining evidence, and making rational judgments are the prerequisites for enjoying promotion dividends.

segments.src: > 提示:本文仅为一般性信息梳理,不构成法律或消费建议。具体活动规则及售后政策,请以各平台官方公示及相关主管部门发布的最新规定为准。
segments.tr: > Tip: This article is only a general information sorting and does not constitute legal or consumption advice. Specific activity rules and after-sales policies shall be subject to official announcements by each platform and the latest regulations issued by relevant competent authorities.

cn-20261008-news-3.title: Nearly One Year Since the Digital RMB Entered the "Interest-Bearing Era": How Digital RMB Wallets Differ from Bank Deposits and Where Daily Use Stands

segments.src: 自2026年1月1日起,数字人民币(e-CNY)钱包进入“计息”阶段:实名钱包中的余额,按照商业银行活期存款的规则计息。对大多数普通人来说,这件事的意义主要在于“放在数币钱包里不再白白没有利息”,而不是“多了一个高收益渠道”。活期利率本就不高,数币钱包的利息同样只是一笔很小的零头。
segments.tr: Starting January 1, 2026, Digital RMB (e-CNY) wallets entered the "interest-bearing" phase: balances in real-name wallets accrue interest according to commercial bank demand deposit rules. For most ordinary people, the significance of this mainly lies in "money kept in the digital RMB wallet is no longer completely interest-free" rather than "gaining a high-yield channel." Demand deposit interest rates are already low, and interest on digital RMB wallets is likewise just a small fraction.

segments.src: 下面把几个常被问到的问题讲清楚。文中涉及的规则与数据可能随政策调整而变化,具体请以中国人民银行及各运营机构的最新公告为准。
segments.tr: Below are clear answers to a few frequently asked questions. The rules and data involved in this text may change with policy adjustments; please refer to the latest official announcements from the People's Bank of China and various operating institutions.

segments.src: ## 一、“有息”到底改变了什么
此前,数字人民币的定位偏向“数字现金”(M0),类似于把纸币和硬币搬到手机里,所以不产生利息。政策调整后,数字人民币的管理框架转向“数字存款货币”:钱包由运营机构(主要是商业银行)管理,实名钱包的余额被纳入银行的存款体系来对待。
segments.tr: Previously, the positioning of the Digital RMB leaned toward "digital cash" (M0), similar to moving paper bills and coins into a mobile phone, and thus did not generate interest. Following the policy adjustment, the management framework of the Digital RMB shifted to "digital deposit currency": wallets are managed by operating institutions (mainly commercial banks), and balances in real-name wallets are treated as part of the bank's deposit system.
This brings a few direct changes:

segments.src: - **按活期存款利率计息**:利率水平参照同一机构的活期存款,并非专属高息产品。
segments.tr: - **Accruing interest at demand deposit rates**: The interest rate level references demand deposits at the same institution, rather than being an exclusive high-yield product.

segments.src: - **纳入存款保险保障范围**:按现行存款保险制度的框架,同一存款人在同一家银行的存款享有一定限额内的保障。具体适用口径请向开户的运营机构确认。
segments.tr: - **Included in deposit insurance coverage**: Under the framework of the current deposit insurance system, deposits of the same depositor in the same bank enjoy protection up to a certain limit. Please confirm the specific applicable scope with the operating institution where the account was opened.

segments.src: - **更接近银行账户**:钱包的性质从“现金型工具”向“账户型工具”靠拢,与银行存款之间的界限变得更模糊。
segments.tr: - **Closer to bank accounts**: The nature of the wallet is moving away from a "cash-type tool" toward an "account-type tool," and the boundary between it and bank deposits is becoming more blurred.

segments.src: ## 二、数币钱包与普通银行存款有何不同
segments.tr: ## II. How Digital RMB Wallets Differ from Ordinary Bank Deposits

segments.src: | 对比项 | 数字人民币钱包 | 普通银行存款账户 |
segments.tr: | Comparison Item | Digital RMB Wallet | Ordinary Bank Deposit Account |

segments.src: | 本质 | 央行发行的数字形态人民币,由运营机构提供钱包服务 | 商业银行吸收的存款,是银行对储户的债务 |
segments.tr: | Essence | Digital form of RMB issued by the central bank, with wallet services provided by operating institutions | Deposits absorbed by commercial banks, representing the bank's debt to the depositor |

segments.src: | 计息 | 实名钱包按活期规则计息 | 活期、定期、大额存单等多种选择 |
segments.tr: | Interest Accrual | Real-name wallets accrue interest according to demand rules | Multiple choices such as demand, time, and large-scale certificates of deposit |

segments.src: | 产品丰富度 | 以支付、转账、小额结算为主 | 存款期限、理财、贷款等配套更完整 |
segments.tr: | Product Richness | Focused primarily on payments, transfers, and small-scale settlement | More complete supporting features such as deposit terms, wealth management, and loans |

segments.src: | 开立方式 | 通过数币App或银行App开立,按实名程度分为不同类别钱包 | 通过银行网点或手机银行开户 |
segments.tr: | Opening Method | Opened via the Digital RMB App or bank apps, categorized into different wallet types based on the degree of real-name verification | Opened through bank branches or mobile banking |

segments.src: | 限额 | 不同类别钱包有各自的单笔、日累计、余额限额 | 视账户类型与风控规则而定 |
segments.tr: | Limits | Different wallet categories have their own single-transaction, daily cumulative, and balance limits | Determined by account type and risk control rules |

segments.src: | 特色功能 | 支持“双离线支付”(双方手机无网络也可完成小额支付)、可编程支付等 | 依赖银行与清算系统 |
segments.tr: | Special Features | Supports "dual offline payments" (small payments can be completed even when both phones lack network connectivity), programmable payments, etc. | Relies on banks and clearing systems |

segments.src: 需要注意的一点是:数币钱包分为不同的实名等级,**并非所有类别的钱包都计息**,匿名程度较高的低等级钱包通常限额更小,计息安排也不同。使用前建议看清所属钱包类别与说明。
segments.tr: One point to note: Digital RMB wallets are divided into different real-name tiers, and **not all categories of wallets accrue interest**. Lower-tier wallets with a higher degree of anonymity typically have smaller limits and different interest-bearing arrangements. Before use, it is recommended to clearly check your wallet category and instructions.

segments.src: ## 三、与微信支付、支付宝有什么区别
segments.tr: ## III. What Are the Differences from WeChat Pay and Alipay?

segments.src: 很多人的第一反应是:我已经有移动支付了,为什么还要数币?
segments.tr: Many people's first reaction is: I already have mobile payment, why do I still need the digital RMB?

segments.src: - **移动支付是“渠道”,数字人民币是“货币本身”。** 微信、支付宝本质上是支付服务平台,背后资金仍在银行或支付机构的体系里流转;数字人民币则是央行发行的法定货币的数字形态。
segments.tr: - **Mobile payment is a "channel," while the Digital RMB is the "currency itself."** WeChat and Alipay are essentially payment service platforms, and the funds behind them still circulate within the systems of banks or payment institutions; the Digital RMB is the digital form of legal tender issued by the central bank.

segments.src: - **使用体验差别不大。** 在线下扫码、碰一碰的场景,普通人几乎感受不到区别。
segments.tr: - **The user experience is largely similar.** In offline scanning or tap-to-pay scenarios, ordinary people can hardly feel the difference.

segments.src: - **数币的差异化能力在特殊场景。** 例如弱网或无网环境下的离线支付、定向发放补贴的可编程性、跨境结算试点等。
segments.tr: - **The differentiated capability of the Digital RMB lies in special scenarios.** For example, offline payments in weak or no-network environments, programmability for targeted distribution of subsidies, and cross-border settlement pilot programs.

segments.src: 换句话说,在日常小额消费上,数币与现有移动支付是“并行关系”,而不是“替代关系”。
segments.tr: In other words, for daily small-scale consumption, the digital RMB and existing mobile payments have a "parallel relationship" rather than a "substitution relationship."

segments.src: ## 四、日常使用场景走到了哪一步
segments.tr: ## IV. Where Daily Use Scenarios Stand

segments.src: 在不少城市,超市、便利店、餐饮、交通、公交地铁等场景已经支持数字人民币支付。部分银行App、数币App还提供了“碰一碰”、硬件钱包等形式。不过,商户的接受度与活动力度存在明显的地区差异,一线及试点城市相对成熟,其他地区体验不一。
segments.tr: In many cities, scenarios such as supermarkets, convenience stores, dining, transportation, and public transit already support Digital RMB payments. Some bank apps and digital RMB apps also provide forms such as "tap-to-pay" and hardware wallets. However, there are obvious regional differences in merchant acceptance and promotional efforts; tier-1 and pilot cities are relatively mature, while other regions have varying experiences.
### 2. Public Services and Government Affairs Scenarios

segments.src: 数字人民币在代发工资、公积金、社保费用缴纳、税费缴纳、部分补贴发放等方面有试点和应用。其优势在于资金流向可追踪、到账规则可预设,适合财政补贴等“专款专用”的场景。
segments.tr: The Digital RMB has pilot applications in areas such as payroll disbursement, housing provident funds, social security fee payments, tax payments, and the distribution of certain subsidies. Its advantage lies in traceable fund flows and pre-set arrival rules, making it suitable for scenarios like fiscal subsidies where funds are "earmarked for specific uses."

segments.src: 跨境是数字人民币最受关注的方向之一。多边央行数字货币桥(mBridge)等项目的目标,是缩短跨境结算链条、降低成本、提升到账速度。2025年,数字人民币国际运营中心在上海成立,也被视为推进跨境应用的配套举措。
segments.tr: Cross-border payments are one of the most watched directions for the Digital RMB. Projects like the的多边央行数字货币桥 (mBridge) aim to shorten cross-border settlement chains, reduce costs, and improve arrival speeds. In 2025, the Digital RMB International Operations Center was established in Shanghai, which is also seen as a supporting measure to promote cross-border applications.

segments.src: 对普通人而言,这一块短期内感知不强:企业贸易结算、机构间清算会先于个人游客支付落地。个人出境旅游时,仍以银行卡、移动支付等方式为主。
segments.tr: For ordinary people, the perception of this area in the short term is not strong: corporate trade settlement and inter-institutional clearing will land before individual tourist payments. When individuals travel abroad, bank cards and mobile payments remain the primary methods.

segments.src: ## 五、普通人到底用不用得上
segments.tr: ## V. Whether Ordinary People Actually Need It

segments.src: 可以用一个简单的思路自测:
segments.tr: You can self-test using a simple framework:

segments.src: - **如果你只想获得稳定、安全的日常支付**:现有的银行卡和移动支付已经足够,数币钱包不是必需品。
segments.tr: - **If you only want stable and secure daily payments**: Existing bank cards and mobile payments are already sufficient, and a digital RMB wallet is not a necessity.

segments.src: - **如果你想体验新功能**:比如离线支付、领取地方发放的数币红包或补贴,可以开一个小额钱包试用。
segments.tr: - **If you want to experience new features**: Such as offline payments, or claiming digital RMB red packets or subsidies issued locally, you can open a small-amount wallet to try out.

segments.src: - **如果你关心利息**:要有现实预期。活期利率很低,把大额资金放在数币钱包里“生息”意义不大;需要获得更高收益,仍需要根据自身风险承受能力在银行存款、国债、货币基金等产品中进行比较,并注意各自的风险和限制。
segments.tr: - **If you care about interest**: Have realistic expectations. Demand interest rates are very low, and putting large amounts of funds into a digital RMB wallet to "earn interest" has little significance; to obtain higher returns, you still need to compare bank deposits, treasury bonds, monetary funds, and other products based on your own risk tolerance, while paying attention to their respective risks and restrictions.

segments.src: - **如果你比较在意隐私和资金安全**:数币钱包设有分级管理,实名钱包与银行账户一样需要遵守反洗钱、反欺诈的要求。请务必保护好支付密码和验证码。
segments.tr: - **If you care more about privacy and fund security**: Digital RMB wallets have graded management, and real-name wallets must comply with anti-money laundering and anti-fraud requirements just like bank accounts. Please be sure to protect your payment password and verification codes.
## VI. A Few Reminders When Using

segments.src: 1. **只通过官方渠道下载App**,如数字人民币App或各大银行官方App,不要点击陌生链接。
segments.tr: 1. **Only download apps through official channels**, such as the Digital RMB App or official apps of major banks, and do not click on unfamiliar links.

segments.src: 2. **警惕“数币投资”“数币返利”类骗局**。数字人民币是法定货币,不是理财产品,也不存在所谓的“内部额度”“升值机会”。
segments.tr: 2. **Beware of scams involving "digital RMB investment" or "digital RMB rebates."** The Digital RMB is a legal tender, not a wealth management product, and there are no such things as "internal quotas" or "appreciation opportunities."

segments.src: 3. **了解钱包限额与规则**,大额资金仍建议放在受保障、透明度高的银行账户中。
segments.tr: 3. **Understand wallet limits and rules**, and it is still recommended to keep large funds in protected, high-transparency bank accounts.

segments.src: 4. **留意利率与规则变化**,具体计息方式以运营机构公告为准。
segments.tr: 4. **Pay attention to changes in interest rates and rules**, and specific interest-accrual methods are subject to announcements by operating institutions.

segments.src: “有息时代”让数字人民币从一种“数字现金”更进一步成为“数字存款”的一部分,制度上与银行账户更接近,使用上也更自然。但从目前的体验来看,它更像是现有支付体系的一个补充:日常消费上与移动支付互补,在公共服务和跨境结算上则有更大的想象空间。对多数普通人来说,**不必焦虑“用不用”,按需体验、理性看待即可**。
segments.tr: The "interest-bearing era" has pushed the Digital RMB further from a kind of "digital cash" into part of "digital deposits," bringing it closer to bank accounts institutionally and making its use more natural. However, judging from current experiences, it is more like a supplement to the existing payment system: complementing mobile payments in daily consumption, while holding greater imaginative space in public services and cross-border settlements. For most ordinary people, **there is no need to be anxious about "whether to use it"; just experience it on demand and view it rationally**.

cn-20261008-intro-logistics-5.title: [Logistics Management #5] Same 60,000 yuan of goods: some turn it 12 times a year, others only 3 times

segments.src: > 库存管理的核心不是"存多少"，而是"转多快、谁在管、哪些值得你花心思"——ABC 分析挑重点，周转率量速度，JIT 与 VMI 换打法。
segments.tr: > The core of inventory management is not "how much to store", but "how fast it turns, who manages it, and which items deserve your attention" — ABC analysis picks out the key items, turnover rate measures speed, and JIT and VMI change the approach.

segments.src: 上一讲我们说过：仓库里堆的不是货，是被冻住的现金。那么问题来了——现金既然被冻住了，怎么让它转起来？
segments.tr: In the last lesson we said: what piles up in a warehouse is not goods, but frozen cash. So the question is — since cash is frozen, how do you get it moving?

segments.src: 第一件事是**分清主次**。任何一家门店、工厂、电商仓，货品都不是平等的。经验上，约 20% 的品项占了 70%～80% 的库存金额，剩下一大堆品项加起来才占很小一块。这就是**ABC 分析**：按"年消耗金额 = 年用量 × 单价"从高到低排序，切成三段——
segments.tr: The first thing is to **separate what matters from what doesn't**. For any store, factory, or e-commerce warehouse, not all goods are equal. Empirically, about 20% of SKUs account for 70%–80% of inventory value, while the remaining large number of SKUs add up to a small share. This is **ABC analysis**: rank by "annual consumption value = annual usage × unit price" from high to low, and split into three tiers——

segments.src: - **A 类**：品项少、金额大。要天天盯、小批量勤补、精细预测。
segments.tr: - **Class A**: few SKUs, large value. Check daily, replenish in small batches frequently, and forecast precisely.

segments.src: - **B 类**：中等。定期检查，用常规规则管理。
segments.tr: - **Class B**: medium. Review periodically and manage with standard rules.

segments.src: - **C 类**：品项多、金额小。别浪费管理精力，多备一点、批量采购反而更省。
segments.tr: - **Class C**: many SKUs, small value. Don't waste management effort; stocking more and ordering in bulk is actually cheaper.

segments.src: 注意排序依据是**金额**，不是"贵不贵"也不是"卖得多不多"。一颗 5 分钱的螺丝，一年用 2000 万颗，它照样可能是 A 类。
segments.tr: Note that the sorting basis is **value**, not "expensive or not" nor "how much it sells." A screw that costs 5 cents, if you use 20 million a year, can still be Class A.

segments.src: 第二件事是**量化速度**，也就是**库存周转率**：
segments.tr: The second thing is to **quantify speed**, namely the **inventory turnover ratio**:

segments.src: 库存周转率（次/年） = 年销货成本 ÷ 平均库存金额
segments.tr: 库存周转率（次/年） = 年销货成本 ÷ 平均库存金额

segments.src: 库存周转天数       = 365 ÷ 库存周转率
segments.tr: 库存周转天数       = 365 ÷ 库存周转率

segments.src: 一年转 12 次，意味着平均每 30 天，仓库里的货就换了一茬；一年转 3 次，就是每一批货要在架子上躺 120 天。同样压着 6 万元的货，前者一年能做出的生意是后者的 4 倍。这就是为什么零售和制造业都把周转率当作核心 KPI。
segments.tr: Turning 12 times a year means that on average, the goods in the warehouse are replaced every 30 days; turning 3 times a year means each batch sits on the shelf for 120 days. With the same 60,000 yuan tied up in goods, the former does 4 times the business the latter does in a year. This is why both retail and manufacturing treat turnover as a core KPI.

segments.src: 但要提醒一句：**周转率不是越高越好**。转得太快往往意味着安全库存被削到见底，一次断供就是缺货、罚款、丢客户。周转率要和缺货率（服务水平）一起看，单看一个都会做出坏决策。
segments.tr: But a reminder: **a higher turnover is not always better**. Turning too fast often means safety stock is cut to the bone, and one supply break means stockouts, penalties, and lost customers. Turnover must be read together with the stockout rate (service level); looking at either alone leads to bad decisions.

segments.src: 第三件事是**换打法**。传统做法是"多备点、别断货"；两种现代做法则从根上换了思路：
segments.tr: The third thing is to **change the approach**. The traditional approach is "stock more, don't run out"; two modern approaches change the thinking at the root:

segments.src: - **JIT（Just-In-Time，准时制）**：由丰田体系发展出来，讲究"需要的东西、在需要的时候、只送需要的量"。库存被当作掩盖问题的水位——水位降下来，设备故障、质量波动、供应商不稳这些"礁石"就会露出来，然后被逐个解决。所以 JIT 从来不是简单的"零库存"，它是一整套要求：小批量、快换模、稳定的质量与配送、离得近的供应商网络。前提不具备就硬压库存，只会把风险转移成停线。
segments.tr: - **JIT (Just-In-Time)**: developed from the Toyota system, it emphasizes "the right items, at the right time, in the right quantity only." Inventory is treated as a water level that hides problems — when the level drops, reefs such as equipment failures, quality fluctuations, and unstable suppliers are exposed and then solved one by one. So JIT is never simply "zero inventory"; it is a whole set of requirements: small batches, fast changeovers, stable quality and delivery, and a supplier network nearby. Forcing inventory down without the prerequisites only shifts the risk into line stoppages.

segments.src: - **VMI（Vendor Managed Inventory，供应商管理库存）**：由供应商来决定给你补多少、什么时候补。买方开放销售和库存数据，供应商据此补货，很多情况下配合寄售（货卖出去才结算）。它的价值在于减少"牛鞭效应"——需求信息在链条上层层放大失真。但 VMI 要成立，靠的是数据共享和信任，而不是把库存压力单方面甩给供应商。
segments.tr: - **VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory)**: the supplier decides how much to replenish and when. The buyer opens sales and inventory data, and the supplier replenishes based on it, often combined with consignment (payment only when goods are sold). Its value lies in reducing the "bullwhip effect" — demand information distorted as it is amplified up the chain. But for VMI to work, it relies on data sharing and trust, not on unilaterally shifting inventory pressure onto the supplier.

segments.src: 杭州一家 40 平米的奶茶店，老板算过一笔账：店里常备的物料平均占用 6 万元，一年的物料成本（销货成本）是 72 万元。
segments.tr: A 40-square-meter milk tea shop in Hangzhou: the owner worked out the numbers. Materials kept on hand averaged 60,000 yuan in value, and the annual material cost (cost of goods sold) was 720,000 yuan.

segments.src: 库存周转率 = 72 万 ÷ 6 万 = 12 次/年
segments.tr: 库存周转率 = 72 万 ÷ 6 万 = 12 次/年

segments.src: **先做 ABC 分析。** 排下来发现，鲜牛奶、招牌茶叶、珍珠这几样只占品项数的一成多，却吃掉了七成以上的库存金额——A 类。各种糖浆、小料是 B 类。吸管、封口膜、纸巾、打包袋是 C 类：单价几分钱，占钱不到 5%，但品项一大堆。于是他把每天的盘点精力全放在 A 类上，C 类改成一次订两个月的量，还能拿到批量价。以前"每样都数一遍"花 40 分钟，现在 10 分钟搞定，还更准。
segments.tr: **First, ABC analysis.** The sorting showed that fresh milk, signature tea leaves, and tapioca pearls account for just over 10% of SKUs but consume more than 70% of inventory value — Class A. Various syrups and toppings are Class B. Straws, sealing film, napkins, and takeaway bags are Class C: each costs a few cents and accounts for less than 5% of money, but there are many SKUs. So he concentrated daily counting effort on Class A, switched Class C to ordering two months' worth at once, and got bulk pricing. Previously "counting every item" took 40 minutes; now it takes 10 minutes, and it's more accurate.

segments.src: **A 类走 JIT 思路。** 鲜牛奶保质期短，改成每天清晨配送，按前一天的销量下单。库存从 3 天量压到 1 天多，报废率明显下降。代价是：他必须换成一家能稳定日配的本地供应商，并且和对方约好晚到怎么补救——这就是 JIT 的"前提条件"，不是光靠少订货就能实现的。
segments.tr: **Class A uses the JIT approach.** Fresh milk has a short shelf life, so it's now delivered every morning, ordered based on the previous day's sales. Inventory dropped from a 3-day supply to about 1 day, and the spoilage rate fell noticeably. The cost: he had to switch to a local supplier that could reliably deliver daily, and agree with them on how to make up for late deliveries — this is JIT's "prerequisite," not something achieved simply by ordering less.

segments.src: **C 类和部分小料谈 VMI。** 包材供应商愿意每周来一次，自己看货架补满，月底按实际用量结算。老板省下了下单和跟单的时间，供应商也因为能看到真实消耗，不用再靠猜来备产能。
segments.tr: **For Class C and some small toppings, he set up VMI.** The packaging supplier agreed to come once a week, check the shelves and refill them, and settle at month-end based on actual usage. The owner saved time on placing orders and following up, and the supplier, able to see real consumption, no longer had to guess when preparing capacity.

segments.src: 半年后，平均库存降到 4 万元，年物料成本因为生意变好升到 80 万元：
segments.tr: Six months later, average inventory dropped to 40,000 yuan, and as business improved, annual material cost rose to 800,000 yuan:

segments.src: 新周转率 = 80 万 ÷ 4 万 = 20 次/年 → 周转天数约 18 天
segments.tr: 新周转率 = 80 万 ÷ 4 万 = 20 次/年 → 周转天数约 18 天

segments.src: 多出来的 2 万元现金，他拿去开了第二家店的定金。请注意：真正省下来的不是"利润"，是**被释放的现金**——这才是库存管理最直接的回报。
segments.tr: The extra 20,000 yuan in cash was used as a deposit for a second store. Note: what was really saved was not "profit" but **released cash** — and that is the most direct return from inventory management.

segments.src: 1. **ABC 分析**按"年消耗金额"把货分成三档，把有限的管理精力压在占钱最多的 A 类上。
segments.tr: 1. **ABC analysis** divides goods into three tiers by "annual consumption value," concentrating limited management effort on Class A, which ties up the most money.

segments.src: 2. **库存周转率 = 年销货成本 ÷ 平均库存金额**，它衡量现金转得多快；但必须和缺货率一起看，不是越高越好。
segments.tr: 2. **Inventory turnover ratio = annual cost of goods sold ÷ average inventory value**, which measures how fast cash turns over; but it must be read together with the stockout rate — higher is not always better.

segments.src: 3. **JIT** 靠稳定的供应与小批量把水位降下来暴露问题，**VMI** 靠数据共享把补货权交给供应商——两者都是协同机制，不是把风险甩给对方。
segments.tr: 3. **JIT** uses stable supply and small batches to lower the water level and expose problems; **VMI** uses data sharing to hand replenishment rights to the supplier — both are collaboration mechanisms, not shifting risk onto the other party.

segments.src: **1.** 某零件单价只有 0.1 元，但一年要用 500 万个。按 ABC 分析，它最可能被归为哪一类？
segments.tr: **1.** A part costs only 0.1 yuan per unit, but 5 million are used per year. Under ABC analysis, which class is it most likely classified as?

segments.src: 无法判断，因为单价太低
segments.tr: Cannot be determined, because the unit price is too low

segments.src: **2.** 某公司年销货成本 1200 万元，平均库存金额 200 万元。它的库存周转率和周转天数分别约为多少？
segments.tr: **2.** A company has annual cost of goods sold of 12 million yuan and average inventory value of 2 million yuan. Approximately what are its inventory turnover ratio and turnover days?

segments.src: **3.**（O/X）VMI 的本质就是让供应商替买方承担库存成本，所以买方不需要向供应商开放销量和库存数据。
segments.tr: **3.** (T/F) The essence of VMI is to let the supplier bear the inventory cost on behalf of the buyer, so the buyer does not need to open sales and inventory data to the supplier.

segments.src: - **ABC 分析**：按年消耗金额把品项分为 A/B/C 三档，实行差异化管理的方法，源于帕累托（80/20）原则。
segments.tr: - **ABC analysis**: a method that classifies SKUs into A/B/C tiers by annual consumption value and applies differentiated management, originating from the Pareto (80/20) principle.

segments.src: - **库存周转率**：年销货成本 ÷ 平均库存金额，表示一年中库存被"换掉"多少次。
segments.tr: - **Inventory turnover ratio**: annual cost of goods sold ÷ average inventory value, indicating how many times inventory is "replaced" in a year.

segments.src: - **库存周转天数**：365 ÷ 库存周转率，表示一批货平均在仓库停留多少天。
segments.tr: - **Inventory turnover days**: 365 ÷ inventory turnover ratio, indicating how many days on average a batch of goods stays in the warehouse.

segments.src: - **JIT（准时制）**：在需要的时间、按需要的数量供应所需物料的生产与补货方式，需要小批量、稳定质量与可靠配送作为前提。
segments.tr: - **JIT (Just-In-Time)**: a production and replenishment method that supplies required materials at the required time and in the required quantity, requiring small batches, stable quality, and reliable delivery as prerequisites.

segments.src: - **VMI（供应商管理库存）**：买方共享需求与库存数据，由供应商决定补货时点与数量的协同补货模式，常与寄售结合；用于缓解需求信息层层放大的"牛鞭效应"。
segments.tr: - **VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory)**: a collaborative replenishment model in which the buyer shares demand and inventory data and the supplier decides the replenishment timing and quantity, often combined with consignment; used to mitigate the "bullwhip effect" of demand information being amplified layer by layer.

segments.src: *正解：**1 - A**。ABC 的排序依据是"年用量 × 单价"的金额，0.1 元 × 500 万个 = 50 万元，金额很大，通常属于 A 类；单价高低本身不是判据。
segments.tr: *Correct answers: **1 - A**. ABC sorting is based on the value of "annual usage × unit price"; 0.1 yuan × 5 million = 500,000 yuan, a large value, so it usually belongs to Class A; unit price itself is not the criterion.

segments.src: **3 - X**。VMI 成立的前提恰恰是买方开放销量与库存数据，供应商才能准确补货；缺少数据共享的"VMI"只是单方面转嫁压力，最终会以涨价或缺货的形式回到买方身上。*
segments.tr: **3 - X**. The premise of VMI is precisely that the buyer opens sales and inventory data so the supplier can replenish accurately; a "VMI" without data sharing merely shifts pressure unilaterally, and it will ultimately return to the buyer in the form of price increases or stockouts.*

cn-20261008-news-1.title: How to Calculate Your Personal Pension Before the Year-End? Understand the 12,000 Yuan Annual Limit, Account Selection, and Contribution Timing in One Article

segments.src: 距离年度缴存截止只剩不到三个月。每到年底,个人养老金就会被反复提起:每年最多可缴1.2万元,缴费部分可以税前扣除。这笔优惠到底能省多少?收入不同的人是否都划算?产品怎么选,钱又什么时候能取?本文按"先算账、再选产品、最后看取出"的顺序,帮普通人理清思路。
segments.tr: With less than three months left until the annual contribution deadline, personal pensions are repeatedly brought up every year-end: you can contribute up to 12,000 yuan per year, and the contributed portion can be deducted before tax. How much can this discount actually save? Is it worthwhile for people with different incomes? How to choose products, and when can the money be withdrawn? This article will help ordinary people clarify their thoughts in the order of "calculate first, then choose products, and finally look at withdrawals."

segments.src: > 说明:本文仅为政策与思路梳理,不构成任何投资或理财建议。具体规则以国家及当地主管部门、银行和个税APP的最新公布为准。
segments.tr: > Note: This article is only a summary of policies and ideas, and does not constitute any investment or financial advice. Specific rules are subject to the latest announcements from national and local competent departments, banks, and the Individual Income Tax APP.

segments.src: ## 一、先搞清楚:个人养老金是什么
segments.tr: ## I. First, Clarify: What is a Personal Pension?

segments.src: 个人养老金是国家政策支持、个人自愿参加、市场化运营的补充养老制度,与基本养老保险、企业年金(职业年金)共同构成养老保障体系的"第三支柱"。
segments.tr: A personal pension is a supplementary pension system supported by national policies, voluntarily participated in by individuals, and operated on a market-oriented basis. Together with basic pension insurance and enterprise annuities (occupational annuities), it constitutes the "third pillar" of the pension security system.

segments.src: - **额度**:每人每年缴费上限为12000元(月均1000元),按自然年度计算,过期不能补缴,也不能累计到下一年。
segments.tr: - **Limit**: The annual contribution limit per person is 12,000 yuan (an average of 1,000 yuan per month), calculated on a calendar year basis. Overdue contributions cannot be made up, nor can they be accumulated to the next year.

segments.src: - **账户**:参加者需开立个人养老金账户,并指定一个本人名下的个人养老金资金账户用于缴费、购买产品和领取。
segments.tr: - **Account**: Participants need to open a personal pension account and designate a personal pension fund account under their own name for contributions, product purchases, and withdrawals.

segments.src: - **税收政策**:缴费环节可在综合所得或经营所得中据实扣除,每年最高12000元;投资收益暂不征税;领取时按3%的税率单独计税。
segments.tr: - **Tax Policy**: The contribution phase can be deducted based on actual facts from comprehensive income or business income, up to a maximum of 12,000 yuan per year; investment income is temporarily tax-exempt; withdrawals are taxed separately at a rate of 3%.

segments.src: 可以用一句话概括:**缴费时少交税,领取时按3%交税,中间的投资收益暂免税。**
segments.tr: It can be summarized in one sentence: **Pay less tax when contributing, pay 3% tax when withdrawing, and investment income in the middle is temporarily tax-free.**

segments.src: ## 二、省多少税?关键看你的边际税率
segments.tr: ## II. How Much Tax Can You Save? It Keyly Depends on Your Marginal Tax Rate

segments.src: 个人养老金的税优并不是"人人省同样多",而是取决于你适用的个税税率档次。
segments.tr: The tax benefits of personal pensions are not "everyone saves the same amount," but depend on your applicable individual income tax bracket.

segments.src: 综合所得适用3%至45%的七级超额累进税率(按年应纳税所得额,即扣除基本减除费用6万元、专项扣除等之后的金额):
segments.tr: Comprehensive income is subject to a seven-level progressive tax rate ranging from 3% to 45% (based on annual taxable income, which is the amount after deducting the basic deduction of 60,000 yuan, special deductions, etc.):

segments.src: | 适用税率 | 年应纳税所得额 |
segments.tr: | Applicable Tax Rate | Annual Taxable Income |

segments.src: 按年缴满12000元计算,缴费当年少缴的税 = 12000 × 适用税率;将来领取时需缴的税 = 12000 × 3% = 360元(不含投资收益部分的计税,仅作简化示意)。两者之差即为"净税优":
segments.tr: Calculated based on a full annual contribution of 12,000 yuan, the tax saved in the year of contribution = 12,000 × applicable tax rate; the tax to be paid upon future withdrawal = 12,000 × 3% = 360 yuan (excluding the tax calculation on the investment income part, simplified for illustration). The difference between the two is the "net tax benefit":

segments.src: | 适用税率 | 当年少缴个税 | 领取时缴税(简化) | 净节省 |
segments.tr: | Applicable Tax Rate | Tax Saved in the Current Year | Tax Paid upon Withdrawal (Simplified) | Net Savings |

segments.src: 从表中可以得出几点判断:
segments.tr: Several conclusions can be drawn from the table:

segments.src: 1. **适用3%档的人**,税优基本被领取时的3%抵消,单从节税角度看意义不大;
segments.tr: 1. **For those in the 3% bracket**, the tax benefit is basically offset by the 3% tax upon withdrawal, making it of little significance from a tax-saving perspective alone;

segments.src: 2. **适用10%及以上档次的人**,税优逐级增加,收入越高越明显;
segments.tr: 2. **For those in the 10% bracket and above**, the tax benefit increases progressively, becoming more significant as income rises;

segments.src: 3. **收入低于个税起征线、本来就不缴个税的人**,缴费部分没有税可抵,不存在节税效应,是否参加应主要看自己对长期储蓄的需求。
segments.tr: 3. **For those whose income is below the individual income tax threshold and who do not pay individual income tax in the first place**, there is no tax to offset from the contribution portion, so there is no tax-saving effect. Whether to participate should mainly depend on their own demand for long-term savings.

segments.src: 别忘了,这只是"税"这一项的账。个人养老金资金封闭运作到领取条件满足,流动性较差,要和自己的资金规划一起权衡,不要只盯着省下的那几百几千元。
segments.tr: Don't forget, this is just the calculation for "tax." Personal pension funds operate in a closed manner until withdrawal conditions are met, resulting in poor liquidity. This should be weighed alongside your own financial planning, rather than just focusing on the hundreds or thousands of yuan saved.

segments.src: ## 三、账户怎么选:开户与缴费的几个要点
segments.tr: ## III. How to Choose an Account: Key Points for Account Opening and Contribution

segments.src: 个人养老金账户可通过全国统一的信息平台(如国家社会保险公共服务平台、掌上12333等入口)或商业银行渠道开立。个人养老金资金账户则在银行开立或指定,用于资金往来。
segments.tr: Personal pension accounts can be opened through the national unified information platform (such as the National Social Insurance Public Service Platform, Mobile 12333, and other portals) or commercial bank channels. Personal pension fund accounts are opened or designated in banks for fund transactions.
You can focus on comparing several aspects:

segments.src: - 可购买的产品是否丰富(储蓄、理财、基金、商业养老保险等是否齐全);
segments.tr: - Whether the available products are rich (whether savings, wealth management, funds, commercial pension insurance, etc., are complete);

segments.src: - 是否有开户、转账或账户管理相关费用;
segments.tr: - Whether there are fees related to account opening, transfer, or account management;

segments.src: - 手机银行操作是否便捷,缴费与产品购买流程是否清晰;
segments.tr: - Whether the mobile banking operation is convenient, and whether the contribution and product purchase processes are clear;

segments.src: - 是否方便与自己现有的银行关系对接。
segments.tr: - Whether it is convenient to connect with your existing banking relationships.

segments.src: 缴费额度可以一次缴,也可以分月缴。需要注意:缴到账户里并不等于已经"用完"优惠,个税扣除以实际缴费金额为准,并且需要完成后续的扣除申报流程。
segments.tr: The contribution limit can be paid in a lump sum or in monthly installments. Note: Contributing to the account does not mean you have "fully used" the benefit. Individual income tax deduction is based on the actual contribution amount, and the subsequent deduction declaration process must be completed.

segments.src: ## 四、缴费时点怎么算:年底前要做哪几件事
segments.tr: ## IV. How to Calculate the Contribution Timing: What to Do Before the Year-End

segments.src: 1. **12月31日前完成缴费**。个人养老金按自然年度计算,缴费入账时间以银行实际入账为准。临近年底操作量大,建议不要拖到最后一两天,避免因系统繁忙、跨行到账等原因错过当年。
segments.tr: 1. **Complete the contribution before December 31**. Personal pensions are calculated on a calendar year basis, and the contribution entry time is subject to the actual entry by the bank. With a high volume of operations near the end of the year, it is recommended not to drag it to the last day or two to avoid missing the current year due to system busy, cross-bank arrival, and other reasons.

segments.src: 2. **选择在哪里办理税前扣除**。通常有两种方式:
segments.tr: 2. **Choose where to handle pre-tax deductions**. There are usually two ways:

segments.src: - 通过任职受雇单位办理扣除(一般在年内或次年按单位安排申报);
segments.tr: - Handle deductions through your employer (usually declared within the year or the following year according to the employer's arrangement);

segments.src: - 在次年3月1日至6月30日的个人所得税年度汇算期间,通过个人所得税APP自行申报扣除。
segments.tr: - Self-declare deductions through the Individual Income Tax APP during the annual individual income tax reconciliation period from March 1 to June 30 of the following year.

segments.src: 3. **保留好凭证**。个人养老金的缴费信息会与个税系统对接,但仍建议留存缴费记录以便核对。
segments.tr: 3. **Keep vouchers**. Personal pension contribution information will be connected with the individual income tax system, but it is still recommended to keep contribution records for verification.

segments.src: 提醒:在不同的扣除路径下,实际"拿到手"的时间不同,走年度汇算可能是在次年才收到退税。是否划算,请以你的实际申报结果为准。
segments.tr: Reminder: Under different deduction paths, the actual time to "get the money" varies. Going through the annual reconciliation may mean receiving the tax refund only in the following year. Whether it is worthwhile, please refer to your actual declaration results.

segments.src: ## 五、产品怎么选:先问自己三个问题
segments.tr: ## V. How to Choose Products: Ask Yourself Three Questions First

segments.src: 个人养老金账户内可投资的产品范围,目前主要包括:个人养老金储蓄、个人养老金理财产品、个人养老金基金(含目标日期、目标风险类)、商业养老保险等。
segments.tr: The scope of investable products in personal pension accounts currently mainly includes: personal pension savings, personal pension wealth management products, personal pension funds (including target date and target risk categories), commercial pension insurance, etc.
Before choosing a product, ask yourself:

segments.src: - **我的风险承受能力如何?** 储蓄、保险偏稳健,基金、理财则有不同程度的净值波动,可能出现亏损。
segments.tr: - **What is my risk tolerance?** Savings and insurance tend to be conservative, while funds and wealth management have varying degrees of net value fluctuations, which may result in losses.

segments.src: - **我距离领取还有多久?** 年轻人投资期限长,可以对波动有更多容忍度;临近领取年龄的人更应关注稳健与流动性安排。
segments.tr: - **How long is it until I withdraw?** Young people have a long investment horizon and can tolerate more volatility; those close to retirement age should focus more on stability and liquidity arrangements.

segments.src: - **我是否能接受长期封闭?** 账户资金原则上要到符合条件时才能领取,不适合作为随时要用的备用金。
segments.tr: - **Can I accept long-term lock-up?** In principle, account funds can only be withdrawn when conditions are met, making them unsuitable as reserve funds for immediate use.

segments.src: 1. **不要被"税优"带着走**。税优是附加福利,产品本身的风险收益才是主体。
segments.tr: 1. **Don't be led by "tax benefits."** Tax benefits are an additional perk; the risk and return of the product itself are the core.

segments.src: 2. **看清费用**。不同产品的管理费、托管费、销售服务费等各不相同,长期持有下费用差异会累积。
segments.tr: 2. **Look closely at fees.** Management fees, custody fees, sales service fees, etc., vary across different products, and fee differences will accumulate over long-term holding.

segments.src: 3. **分散而非押注**。可以在不同类型的产品之间做搭配,必要时可以调整投资组合(以产品规则为准)。
segments.tr: 3. **Diversify rather than bet.** You can mix and match different types of products, and adjust your investment portfolio when necessary (subject to product rules).

segments.src: 4. **理解"目标日期基金"这类产品**:它们会随着临近目标年份逐步调整资产配置,适合不想频繁操作的人,但同样不保证收益。
segments.tr: 4. **Understand products like "target date funds"**: They will gradually adjust asset allocation as they approach the target year, suitable for people who do not want to operate frequently, but they also do not guarantee returns.
## VI. When Can the Money Be Withdrawn?

segments.src: 个人养老金的领取有明确条件,符合以下情形之一的,可以申请领取:
segments.tr: There are clear conditions for withdrawing personal pensions. You can apply for withdrawal if you meet one of the following circumstances:

segments.src: - 达到领取基本养老金的年龄;
segments.tr: - Reaching the age to receive basic pension;
- Completely losing the ability to work;

segments.src: - 国家规定的其他情形(具体以最新政策为准)。
segments.tr: - Other circumstances prescribed by the state (subject to the latest policies).

segments.src: 领取时按3%的税率单独计税,税款由开户的商业银行代扣代缴并计入当期的税务处理。领取方式可以是分期、一次性或按本人选择的方式,具体以银行规则为准。
segments.tr: Upon withdrawal, tax is calculated separately at a rate of 3%, and the tax is withheld and paid by the commercial bank where the account is opened and included in the current tax processing. The withdrawal method can be in installments, in a lump sum, or in a manner chosen by the individual, subject to bank rules.

segments.src: 这意味着:**如果你预期未来十几年甚至几十年内都不会动用这笔钱,个人养老金才比较适合你。** 对于近期有购房、子女教育、医疗等大额支出计划的人,应优先保障流动性。
segments.tr: This means: **If you do not expect to use this money for the next ten or even dozens of years, personal pensions are more suitable for you.** For those with large expenditure plans in the near future, such as buying a house, children's education, or medical care, liquidity should be prioritized.
## VII. "Calculation Logic" for Several Types of People

segments.src: - **适用税率10%至20%的工薪族**:每年净节省大致在几百到两千多元,可以按月小额定投,既摊平缴费压力,也养成长期储蓄习惯;
segments.tr: - **Salaried workers with an applicable tax rate of 10% to 20%**: The net annual savings are roughly several hundred to over two thousand yuan. You can make small monthly fixed investments, which both flattens contribution pressure and helps build a long-term savings habit;

segments.src: - **适用税率25%及以上的较高收入者**:节税幅度更明显,值得优先考虑把额度缴满,但仍需结合自己的现金流与投资偏好;
segments.tr: - **Higher-income earners with an applicable tax rate of 25% and above**: The tax-saving effect is more significant, and it is worth prioritizing filling up the limit, but still needs to be combined with your own cash flow and investment preferences;

segments.src: - **适用3%档的人**:税优有限,可以更多从"强制储蓄""长期规划"的角度权衡,不必为了凑额度而影响正常生活;
segments.tr: - **Those in the 3% bracket**: Tax benefits are limited. You can weigh it more from the perspective of "forced savings" and "long-term planning," without affecting normal life just to make up the limit;

segments.src: - **自由职业者与个体经营者**:个人养老金的扣除同样可适用于经营所得的相关规定,具体申报方式请参考税务部门的最新说明;
segments.tr: - **Freelancers and self-employed individuals**: Personal pension deductions can also apply to relevant regulations on business income. Please refer to the latest instructions from the tax department for specific declaration methods;

segments.src: - **本年已无法缴满的人**:当年额度不可补缴,可以从明年起规划,避免在年末被动"冲业绩"。
segments.tr: - **Those who can no longer make full contributions this year**: The current year's limit cannot be made up. You can plan from next year to avoid passively "rushing performance" at the end of the year.

segments.src: 1. **"缴得越多省得越多"**:单年上限就是12000元,超过部分无法享受税前扣除,账户也不接受超额缴费。
segments.tr: 1. **"The more you contribute, the more you save"**: The single-year limit is 12,000 yuan. The excess part cannot enjoy pre-tax deductions, and the account does not accept excess contributions.

segments.src: 2. **"税优等于收益"**:税优只是少交的税,产品本身仍可能亏损。
segments.tr: 2. **"Tax benefits equal returns"**: Tax benefits are just less tax paid; the product itself may still lose money.

segments.src: 3. **"缴了就一定能退税"**:是否有税可退,取决于你全年的应纳税额与适用税率。
segments.tr: 3. **"Contributing guarantees a tax refund"**: Whether there is a tax refund depends on your annual taxable income and applicable tax rate.

segments.src: 4. **"随时可以取出来用"**:个人养老金需满足条件才能领取,提前动用可能无法办理或面临限制。
segments.tr: 4. **"Can be withdrawn for use at any time"**: Personal pensions must meet conditions to be withdrawn. Early withdrawal may not be processed or may face restrictions.

segments.src: 5. **"到年底再决定也来得及"**:临近年底时段,银行渠道、产品额度与到账时间都可能有变化,宜尽早安排。
segments.tr: 5. **"It's still in time to decide at the end of the year"**: Near the end of the year, bank channels, product quotas, and arrival times may change, so it is advisable to arrange as early as possible.
## IX. Action List Before the Year-End

segments.src: - [ ] 确认自己去年的适用税率档位(可参考个税APP的年度汇总信息);
segments.tr: - [ ] Confirm your applicable tax rate bracket from last year (refer to the annual summary information on the Individual Income Tax APP);

segments.src: - [ ] 评估今年还能缴多少,是否要一次性补足,还是按月拆分;
segments.tr: - [ ] Assess how much you can still contribute this year, whether to make up the full amount in a lump sum, or split it monthly;

segments.src: - [ ] 对比银行和产品,选定符合自己风险偏好的品种;
segments.tr: - [ ] Compare banks and products, and select varieties that match your risk preference;

segments.src: - [ ] 12月中旬前完成缴费,留足到账时间;
segments.tr: - [ ] Complete the contribution before mid-December to leave enough arrival time;

segments.src: - [ ] 来年汇算期内核对扣除信息,及时申报。
segments.tr: - [ ] Verify deduction information during the reconciliation period next year and declare in a timely manner.

segments.src: 个人养老金是一种"用长期换税优"的工具:对中高税率档的人而言,每年1.2万元的额度确实能带来可观的节税空间;对低税率档的人,更多是一种长期储蓄的补充安排。合不合适,最终还是要回到自己的收入结构、资金需求和风险偏好。在年底之前花一点时间把账算清楚,比盲目跟风更重要。
segments.tr: Personal pension is a tool that "exchanges long-term for tax benefits": for those in medium-to-high tax brackets, the annual limit of 12,000 yuan can indeed bring considerable tax-saving space; for those in low tax brackets, it is more of a supplementary arrangement for long-term savings. Whether it is suitable ultimately goes back to your income structure, capital needs, and risk preference. Spending a little time before the end of the year to calculate clearly is more important than blindly following the trend.
